description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'LocalStore' used for lightweight local key-value persistence in an Android app, utilizing SharedPreferences for storing and retrieving data such as shopping cart contents, recent searches, catalog filter options, and favorites.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class for managing local persistent storage of application state data such as cart, recent searches, filters, and favorites.

methods.name: readCart
methods.description: Reads the persisted shopping cart as a map of product ID to quantity.

methods.name: writeCart
methods.description: Persists the shopping cart map into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readRecentSearches
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recent search terms.

methods.name: writeRecentSearches
methods.description: Stores the list of recent search terms.

methods.name: readCatalogSelectedCategoryId
methods.description: Reads the currently selected catalog category ID.

methods.name: writeCatalogSelectedCategoryId
methods.description: Stores the selected catalog category ID, or null for 'All'.

methods.name: readCatalogSortKey
methods.description: Gets the current catalog sort key.

methods.name: readFavoriteProductIds
methods.description: Retrieves the set of favorite product IDs.

methods.name: writeFavoriteProductIds
methods.description: Stores the set of favorite product IDs.

methods.name: readCatalogFavoritesOnly
methods.description: Reads whether the 'Favorites only' filter is enabled.
